mapper.select:

ORDER BY crd02_approval_dt, crd02_approval_time, crd02_franchise_nm LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT , crd02_confirm_yn AS confirm_yn
ORDER BY crd02_approval_dt, crd02_approval_time, crd02_franchise_nm

SELECT crd11_excel_code_id AS excel_code_id , crd11_company_id AS company_id , crd11_bank_cd AS bank_code , f_cdnm('CreditCardCompany', crd11_bank_cd, crd11_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS bank_name , crd11_bank_excel_cd AS bank_excel_code , f_cdnm('CreditCardExcelCode', crd11_bank_excel_cd, crd11_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS bank_excel_name , crd11_seq AS seq , crd11_note AS text FROM crd11_excel_code WHERE crd11_bank_cd = #{bankCode} AND crd11_company_id = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crd11_excel_code WHERE crd11_company_id = #{companyId} AND crd11_bank_cd = #{bankCode}) THEN #{companyId} ELSE 0 END
mapper.sql: count(*) AS data_count , count(*) FILTER (WHERE pid IS NOT NULL) AS confirm_count , count(*) FILTER (WHERE pid IS NOT NULL AND cl = 'true') AS close_count
mapper.select: SELECT FROM (SELECT (SELECT biz01_promo_id FROM biz01_promo WHERE biz01_card_data_id = d.crd02_data_id AND biz01_company_id = #{companyId} LIMIT 1) AS pid , (SELECT biz01_close_yn FROM biz01_promo WHERE biz01_card_data_id = d.crd02_data_id AND biz01_company_id = #{companyId} LIMIT 1) AS cl FROM crd02_data d WHERE d.crd02_data_ym LIKE #{dataYm} AND d.crd02_company_id = #{companyId}) t

SELECT FROM (SELECT (SELECT biz01_promo_id FROM biz01_promo WHERE biz01_card_data_id = d.crd02_data_id AND biz01_company_id = #{companyId} LIMIT 1) AS pid , (SELECT biz01_close_yn FROM biz01_promo WHERE biz01_card_data_id = d.crd02_data_id AND biz01_company_id = #{companyId} LIMIT 1) AS cl FROM crd02_data d WHERE d.crd02_company_id = #{companyId} AND d.crd02_data_id IN #{id}) t

SELECT crd01_card_id AS card_id , crd03_public_yn AS public_yn , crd03_person_id AS card_manager_id FROM crd01_card INNER JOIN crd03_trans ON ( crd03_card_id = crd01_card_id AND #{approvalDate}::date BETWEEN crd03_fr_dt AND COALESCE(crd03_to_dt, '9999-12-31')) WHERE crd01_card_no = #{cardNo} AND crd01_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz01_promo ( biz01_promo_id, biz01_company_id, biz01_provide_date, biz01_provide_rcv_type, biz01_settle_type , biz01_card_data_id, biz01_card_id, biz01_provide_amt, biz01_tax, biz01_std_ym, biz01_tax_type, biz01_real_person_id ) VALUES ( #{promoId}, #{companyId}, #{row.approvalDt}, '1', '1' , #{row.dataId}, #{cardId}, #{amount}, #{tax}, #{row.dataYm}, #{taxType}, #{realPersonId} )
